app_consent._comment: Risk tiers for Microsoft Graph permissions as THIS organisation rates them. 'delegated' / 'application' give the risk of each permission type; a type that is missing does not exist for that permission. 'delegated_admin_only' marks delegated permissions that Microsoft Graph always requires an administrator to consent to. Any permission or type not listed here is treated as critical (deny by default).

user_consent_settings.do_not_allow: Do not allow user consent: an administrator must consent for every app.
user_consent_settings.verified_publishers_low_impact: Allow user consent for apps from verified publishers (or registered in this organisation), for permissions classified as low impact.
user_consent_settings.allow_all: Allow user consent for all apps (legacy, not recommended by Microsoft).

concepts.delegated permission: Access an app uses on behalf of a signed-in user, limited to what that user could do themselves.
concepts.application permission: Access an app uses as itself with no signed-in user, usually across the whole tenant, which only an administrator can grant.
concepts.admin consent workflow: A setting that lets users ask for an app they cannot consent to, sending the request to named reviewers instead of a dead end.
concepts.publisher verification: A blue badge showing the app's developer proved their identity with a Microsoft partner account linked to the app's domain.
concepts.permission classification: An administrator's label marking some delegated permissions as low impact so users may consent to them alone.
concepts.illicit consent grant: An attack where a user is tricked into approving a malicious app, giving the attacker data access without stealing a password.
concepts.multi-tenant application: An app registration that accounts from any Microsoft Entra tenant can sign in to, not just its home organisation.
concepts.app governance: The Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps feature that watches OAuth apps' permissions and activity and can ban risky ones.
